name: Question 6
problem:
Given that $|R\times R|=c,$ complete the following reasoning about the cardinality of the set $R\times [-5,6):$

Since the function $f:(x,y)\to (x,y)$ (that maps any ordered pair to itself) is an injection from $R\times [-5,6)$ into $R\times R,$ and 

$$
g:(x,y)\to (x,{{field-1}}{{field-2}})
$$

is an injection from $R\times R$ onto $R\times (-5,5)⊆R\times [-5,6),$ according to Cantor-Bernstein-Schröder theorem, we have that 
$|R\times [-5,6)|=$ {{field-3}}.
